# W Total Home Solutions LLC

> Home remodeling & repair based in Harker Heights, Texas. Wilber Gomez and his crew rebuild bathrooms, decks, fences and water-damaged rooms around Harker Heights and Killeen. Reviewers say they come out the same day and often start the next.

- Phone: (254) 658-9141

## Services
- Bathrooms & walk-in showers: Tub-to-shower conversions and floor-to-ceiling tile showers with niches, glass and grab bars.
- Water damage rebuilds: Same-day assessments after a leak or burst pipe, then subfloor, drywall and finishes put back.
- Decks, balconies & patio covers: New patio covers, rebuilt balconies and porches, and decks stained and refinished.
- Fences & gates: Stained horizontal and privacy fences with matching gates.
- Painting & flooring: Interior and exterior paint, new tile floors and subfloor replacement.
- Make-ready & home repairs: Rental turnovers for property managers, plus doors, windows, dog doors, plumbing and electrical.

## About
W Total Home Solutions LLC is a remodeling and repair company based in Harker Heights and run by its owner, Wilber Gomez. Reviewers name Wilber on nearly every job, along with crew members like Freddie. The company runs a red, white and blue work van and trailer. The work spans many trades: tile showers and tub conversions, balconies, decks and patio covers, fences, paint, flooring, electrical and plumbing repairs. One property manager calls the company one of its most trusted make-ready partners, and one homeowner had the crew assessing a burst pipe the same day and rebuilding the next.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Can you help after a pipe bursts?
  A: Yes. One homeowner had W Total out the same day to assess a flooded room, and the rebuild started the next day.
- Q: Do you convert tubs to walk-in showers?
  A: Yes. Wilber and Freddie have converted tubs to tiled walk-in showers, with grab bars where they are needed.
- Q: Do you work with property managers?
  A: Yes. A local property manager calls W Total one of its longest-standing make-ready partners for getting homes ready for new residents.
- Q: Can one crew handle several projects?
  A: Yes. Reviewers hired Wilber for paint, plumbing, electrical, tile and carpentry, sometimes fixing an earlier handyman's mistakes.
- Q: Which cities do you serve?
  A: Harker Heights, Killeen, Copperas Cove, Nolanville, Belton and Temple.
